verdict.rationale: Convertio says it supports over 25,600 conversions across 300+ formats and lists a Presentation Converter, which points to PowerPoint support. The pack never names Word, Excel, or PDF output specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Word/Excel/PowerPoint-to-PDF conversion, documented conversion between office formats (e.g., DOCX↔ODT, XLSX↔CSV), a named Document or Spreadsheet converter, and hands-on corroboration of output fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: We support more than 25600 different conversions between more than 300 different file formats.
